name: Geu Kkochgil, Meomuneun Janhyang (Season 2)
source:
Could a second chance at love really be as impossible as they say? Your ex-girlfriend still loves you, even after 7 years have passed after your break up. And she's willing to do whatever it takes to win your heart.

[From in-app]
translation:
破镜重圆，真像人们所说的那么不可能吗？分手已过7年，前女友依然爱着你。而为了重新赢得你的心，她愿意付出一切。

[摘自应用内]
